title: Least Squares
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Least
learningObjectives: Explain why the drawn square for each data point has an area equal to the squared vertical residual between the point and the line
Adjust the slope and intercept sliders to minimize the total area of the four squares and identify the resulting best-fit line
Predict how moving the intercept slider shifts the line vertically while leaving its steepness unchanged
Compare the effect on total squared error of a small slope change versus an equal intercept change
Explain why least squares penalizes a large residual far more than several small ones
